files.P1/node.yaml:
id: P1
kind: purpose
fields:
  statement: Help an individual keep in touch with selected people at a personally meaningful frequency and depth, while respecting both people's autonomy.
  intendedChange: More wanted contact and less effort remembering or initiating it.
  successCriteria:
    - More wanted contact happens with the people the owner chose to keep in touch with.
    - Less effort is needed to remember or initiate contact.
    - Both people's autonomy is respected; unwanted pressure does not rise.
  nonGoals:
    - Time spent in the app (diagnostic measure only)
    - Message volume (diagnostic measure only)
    - Notification opens (diagnostic measure only)
    - Streak penalties, public relationship scores and group discussion (spec §3)
  constraints:
    - Private contacts, goals and notes stay owner-only; connecting accounts adds consensual sharing capabilities and does not turn private notes or goals into shared data.
    - The app can help before any friend installs it.
  source:
    doc: peopling-world-specification
    section: "1"
links:
  - { rel: beneficiary, to: ext.owner }
  - { rel: beneficiary, to: ext.contacts }
files.T1/node.yaml:
id: T1
kind: claim
fields:
  name: Remembering
  purpose: P1
  mechanism: Private context and a chosen cadence reduce forgetting
  outcome: Wanted contact happens more reliably
  indicator: Weekly proportion of active goals satisfied by qualifying contact; denominator excludes paused goals
  evaluationMethod: Two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and interview participants. A later randomized or staggered comparison with consent and a defined outcome protocol can test T1-T3.
  limitation: Missing baseline remains unknown; a before-and-after improvement cannot establish causality; no numerical effect target is set. Does not assume more frequent contact always improves a relationship.
  activities:
    - GD.contacts
    - GD.goals
    - GD.prompts
  kind: hypothesis
  status: unknown
  deferred: false
links:
  - { rel: beneficiary, to: ext.owner }

id: system.peopling
kind: system
template: template.system.social-networking.cloudflare@1
fields:
  name: Peopling
  profile: profile.private-relationships
  phase: unrealized
  kits:
    - id: privacy
      version: "1"
    - id: consent
      version: "1"
    - id: topology.private-pairs
      version: "1"
    - id: notification-restraint
      version: "1"
    - id: accessibility
      version: "1"
    - id: cloudflare-webapp
      version: "1"
  rulePacks:
    - id: metamodel
      version: "1"
    - id: readiness
      version: "1"
    - id: authorization
      version: "1"
    - id: theory
      version: "1"
    - id: journeys
      version: "1"
    - id: topology.private-pairs
      version: "1"
  required:
    - privacy
    - consent
    - topology.private-pairs
    - notification-restraint
    - accessibility
    - cloudflare-webapp
    - auth
  narrative: The main experience is a purposeful contacts app. People are the organizing unit. Each relationship has an owner-only intention such as “check in every two weeks” or “make room for a proper conversation monthly.” A calm Today view suggests a finite set of next actions. A user can act, log contact, snooze, pause or revise the goal. There are no streak penalties or public relationship scores.
  alternatives:
    - "Reader-driven digest publication (proposed interpretation): an author publishes an owned edition and approved subscribers independently read it; replies remain one-to-one and readers cannot see or address one another."
    - Retain only individually addressed updates, if “no one-to-many outgoing” prohibits all shared digest visibility.
    - Shared intentions - two people agree on a joint contact rhythm as a new consented object that never exposes either private goal.
  openQuestions:
    - "Digest interpretation: this still distributes one author's information to many people. If “no one-to-many outgoing” prohibits all such visibility, shared digests conflict with it. Digest realization stays blocked until that interpretation is accepted."
    - Photo suggestions need a device capability adapter, local or provider processing and an approval contract before any upload or send.
    - Groups need their own Purpose, membership and topology contract and an accepted Evolution; disabled in this System.
    - Live messaging may need Durable Objects only if a later messaging Evolution requires coordinated live state.

    title: System structure is complete
    claim: Require exactly one app Thing, thing.webapp, with a specification and artifact.webapp binding; require Purpose, Externals, Theory and ontology references. Reject dangling references or domain types incorrectly declared as independently realized Things
    gates:
      - submission
      - promotion
    sourceRefs:
      - P1
    hooks:
      - id: hook.system.structure

        tier: basic
        engine: model-rules
        triggers:
          - submission
        inputs:
          packs: metamodel@1
        binding: bound
  - id: C.system.purpose
    title: Theory supports the Purpose
    claim: Require T1–T5 to link activities, intended outcomes, measures and limitations to P1. Model validation rejects missing measures or engagement substituted for wanted contact; pilot outcome hooks record support, challenge or unknown separately from conformance
    gates:
      - submission
      - promotion
    sourceRefs:
      - P1
      - T1
      - T2
      - T3
      - T4
      - T5
    hooks:
      - id: hook.system.purpose.model
        assay: system.purpose.model
        tier: semantic
        engine: system-one
        triggers:
          - submission
        inputs:
          packs: theory@1
        costTier: cheap
        binding: bound
      - id: hook.system.purpose.outcome
        assay: system.purpose.outcome
        tier: semantic
        engine: llm
        target: observation
        triggers:
          - outcome
        inputs:
          protocol: two-week baseline, four-week pilot; no invented numeric target
        costTier: expensive
  - id: C.system.topology
    title: Communication topology holds
    claim: Require two-endpoint pairs, one target per outgoing direct action, private incoming aggregation and disabled group scope. Model validation rejects recipient arrays or an enabled digest without an accepted publication contract; C.webapp.outgoing.single supplies implementation evidence
    gates:
      - submission
      - promotion
    sourceRefs:
      - GD.connect
    hooks:
      - id: hook.system.topology
        assay: system.topology
        tier: basic
        engine: model-rules
        triggers:
          - submission
          - promotion
        inputs:
          packs: topology.private-pairs@1
        binding: bound
      - id: hook.system.topology.semantic
        assay: system.topology.semantic
        tier: semantic
        engine: system-one
        triggers:
          - submission
        costTier: cheap
        binding: bound
  - id: C.system.autonomy
    title: Autonomy is preserved
    claim: Require owner-only goals and notes, explicit consent, revocation and notification bounds across enabled scope. A coverage hook must resolve these obligations to C.webapp.private.owner, C.webapp.connection.consent, C.webapp.revocation.current and C.webapp.prompts.bounded
    gates:
      - submission
      - promotion
    sourceRefs:
      - P1
      - T4
    hooks:
      - id: hook.system.autonomy
        assay: system.autonomy.coverage
        tier: basic
        engine: model-rules
        triggers:
          - submission
          - promotion
        inputs:
          packs: authorization@1
          requires: C.webapp.private.owner,C.webapp.connection.consent,C.webapp.revocation.current,C.webapp.prompts.bounded
  - id: C.system.readiness
    title: Specification is ready to realize
    claim: Require every enabled specification requirement to resolve to a protected criterion and executable hook, with Kits and versions pinned. Excluded later modules do not block the core; an enabled module with missing contracts or hooks does
    gates:
      - submission
      - promotion
    hooks:
      - id: hook.system.readiness
        assay: system.readiness
        tier: basic
        engine: model-rules
        triggers:
          - submission
          - promotion
        inputs:
          packs: readiness@1
        binding: bound
  - id: C.system.promotion
    title: Promotion is evidence-backed
    claim: Require the expected current base, authorized Evolution scope, exact final Artifact manifest and fresh required System and Thing evidence. A stale base or evidence for a different candidate blocks promotion; composed candidates require new evidence
    gates:
      - submission
      - promotion
    hooks:
      - id: hook.system.promotion
        assay: system.promotion
        tier: basic
        engine: model-rules
        triggers:
          - submission

        inputs:
          check: base-current,scope-authorized,manifest-exact,evidence-fresh

  - id: C.system.concurrency

    severity: soft
